Contract ManageStoreCRUDService::deleteStore(id: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		store: Store = Store.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id)
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer)
	postcondition:
		store.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		Store.allInstance()->excludes(store) and
		result = true or
		store.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = false
}
